import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from harness import *

def A(payload,pn,dcid=b'\xaa',phase=0,expected=None):
    # expected = previous accepted largest +1; default sequential
    return datagram(bytes([0x40|(phase<<2)])+dcid+pn.to_bytes(1,'big')+payload,[0])
EMPTY=sha(b'')

t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x0b'+v(0)+v(1)+b'a',0), A(b'\x0b'+v(4)+v(1)+b'b',1)]))
check('implicit-open',(t['opened'],t['used'],[s['id'] for s in t['streams']]),({'bidi':2,'uni':0},2,[4]))
check('implicit-row',(t['streams'][0]['high'],t['streams'][0]['ranges'],t['streams'][0]['unique'],t['streams'][0]['prefix']),(1,[[0,1]],1,1))

# server stream already open
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x0b'+v(1)+v(1)+b'a',0)]))
check('server-stream',(t['opened'],t['used'],[s['id'] for s in t['streams']]),({'bidi':0,'uni':0},1,[1]))
# server unopened (local.bidi=1 -> ids 1,5; use 5)
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x0b'+v(5)+v(1)+b'a',0)],local_bidi=1))
check('server-unopened',status(t),'STREAM_STATE_ERROR')
# server uni receive ref id 3
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x0b'+v(3)+v(1)+b'a',0)]))
check('server-uni-recv',status(t),'STREAM_STATE_ERROR')
# send ref on client uni id2
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x05'+v(2)+v(1),0)]))
check('stop-client-uni',status(t),'STREAM_STATE_ERROR')
# send ref on server uni id3 (local.uni=2)
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x05'+v(3)+v(1),0)]))
check('stop-server-uni',(status(t),t['streams'][0]['stop'],t['opened']),('OK',1,{'bidi':0,'uni':0}))
# client uni stream id2 receive
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x0b'+v(2)+v(1)+b'a',0)]))
check('client-uni',(t['opened'],t['used']),({'bidi':0,'uni':1},1))
# client limit exceeded
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x0b'+v(8)+v(1)+b'a',0)],bidi=2))
check('client-limit',status(t),'STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR')
# implicit opening rolls back on later failure
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x0b'+v(4)+v(1)+b'a'+b'\x20',0)]))
check('implicit-rollback',(t['opened'],t['streams']),({'bidi':0,'uni':0},[]))

# ---- flow control ----
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']},
             A(b'\x0f'+v(0)+v(0)+v(5)+b'a'*5,0),
             A(b'\x0b'+v(0)+v(5)+v(1)+b'b',1)],stream_credit=5))
check('fc-stream',(t['packets'][1]['status'],t['streams'][0]['high']),('FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR',5))
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']},
             A(b'\x0f'+v(0)+v(0)+v(5)+b'a'*5,0),
             A(b'\x0f'+v(4)+v(0)+v(4)+b'b'*4,1)],connection=8))
check('fc-conn',(t['packets'][1]['status'],t['used'],t['opened']),('FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR',5,{'bidi':1,'uni':0}))
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']},
             A(b'\x0f'+v(0)+v(0)+v(5)+b'a'*5,0),
             A(b'\x0f'+v(4)+v(0)+v(3)+b'b'*3,1)],connection=8))
check('fc-ok',(t['packets'][1]['status'],t['used'],t['opened']),('OK',8,{'bidi':2,'uni':0}))
# holes consume credit
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x0b'+v(0)+v(3)+v(2)+b'xy',0)]))

      (5,[[3,5]],2,0,EMPTY,5))
# zero length stream sets high

             A(b'\x0b'+v(0)+v(2)+b'ab',0),

# reset before any stream data
t=one(trace([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x04'+v(0)+v(5)+v(4),0)]))

             A(b'\x05'+v(0)+v(7),0),
